title: Asking the Way to the Library
audience: Chinese primary school students (10-12 years old, average level in mainland China)
imageAlt: A schoolgirl asking a traffic police officer for directions in front of a big town map board, with a golden puppy at her feet
imageDescription: A sunny street corner in a town. A big green information board titled TOWN MAP takes up most of the picture. On the map, Moon Road runs from top to bottom on the left and Green Street runs across the middle. The SCHOOL is in the upper left and the HOSPITAL below it; the PARK with trees is in the upper middle and the LIBRARY next to it on the right; a BUS STOP is in the lower middle and the ZOO on the lower right. A red star marked YOU ARE HERE sits at the bottom of Moon Road. A red dotted route goes straight up Moon Road and through the park to the library; a blue dotted route goes along Green Street and then turns up to the library. A notice says LIBRARY OPEN 9:00-17:00 CLOSED MONDAYS. A girl in a red dress, Yuanyuan, points at the map and asks a kneeling traffic police officer in a blue uniform. A golden puppy with a red collar sits beside her. Behind them are a police booth, a red traffic light, a zebra crossing and a large LIBRARY building.
scoringDescription: A sunny street corner in a Chinese town, drawn as a bright cartoon. The main element is a large green town map board titled TOWN MAP. On the board, Moon Road runs vertically on the left and Green Street runs horizontally across the middle, crossing each other. Buildings around the roads: SCHOOL (upper left, with a clock tower), HOSPITAL (lower left, with a red cross), PARK (upper middle, green with trees), LIBRARY (upper right, with a big open-book symbol on the roof), BUS STOP (lower middle, with a bus icon and a bench), ZOO (lower right, with a lion and a giraffe under an arch). A red star labelled YOU ARE HERE is at the bottom of Moon Road. Two dotted routes connect the star to the library: the RED route goes straight up Moon Road, then cuts across the park directly to the library (the shorter way); the BLUE route goes along Green Street first, then turns north up to the library (the longer way). A white notice panel at the bottom left of the board reads LIBRARY OPEN 9:00-17:00 CLOSED MONDAYS, so the library closes at five in the afternoon and does not open on Mondays. In front of the board, schoolgirl Yuanyuan (short black hair, red dress, red backpack) points at the map and asks a friendly traffic police officer in a blue uniform and white cap, who kneels on one knee and gestures the way with a white-gloved hand. A big golden puppy with a red collar sits at her feet looking up. In the background there is a small police booth signed POLICE, a traffic light showing red, a zebra crossing, green trees, and on the right a real LIBRARY building with a large blue sign over its columns.
